schema: CREATE TABLE a(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER,v INTEGER,label TEXT);CREATE TABLE b(bid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER,w INTEGER,note TEXT);CREATE TABLE c(cid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER,z INTEGER)

cases.name: right_join
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,a.v,b.w FROM a RIGHT JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

cases.name: full_join
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,a.v,b.w FROM a FULL OUTER JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

cases.name: left_residual
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,a.v,b.w FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.k=b.k AND a.v<b.w

cases.name: full_residual
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,a.v,b.w FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.k=b.k AND a.v<b.w

cases.name: theta_join
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid FROM a JOIN b ON a.v<b.w

cases.name: cross_join
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid FROM a CROSS JOIN b

cases.name: comma_filter
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid FROM a,b WHERE a.k=b.k AND a.v<b.w

cases.name: using_inner
cases.query: SELECT k,a.id,b.bid FROM a JOIN b USING(k)

cases.name: using_full
cases.query: SELECT k,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,a.id,b.bid FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(k)

cases.name: natural_left
cases.query: SELECT k,a.id,b.bid FROM a NATURAL LEFT JOIN b

cases.name: using_star
cases.query: SELECT * FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(k)
cases.pg_query: SELECT a.id,coalesce(a.k,b.k) AS k,a.v,a.label,b.bid,b.w,b.note FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(k)

cases.name: qualified_star
cases.query: SELECT a.*,b.bid,b.w,b.note FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(k)
cases.pg_query: SELECT a.id,coalesce(a.k,b.k) AS k,a.v,a.label,b.bid,b.w,b.note FROM a FULL JOIN b USING(k)

cases.name: self_outer
cases.query: SELECT a.id AS x,b.id AS y,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk FROM a FULL JOIN a b ON a.k=b.k

cases.name: outer_chain
cases.query: SELECT a.id,b.bid,c.cid,a.k AS ak,b.k AS bk,c.k AS ck FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.k=b.k FULL JOIN c ON b.k=c.k

cases.name: filtered_exists
cases.query: SELECT a.id,a.k FROM a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b WHERE a.k=b.k AND b.w>0)

cases.name: filtered_not_exists
cases.query: SELECT a.id FROM a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b WHERE a.k=b.k AND b.w>a.v)

cases.name: joined_exists
cases.query: SELECT a.id,a.k FROM a WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b JOIN c ON b.k=c.k WHERE a.k=b.k AND c.z>0)

cases.name: nullable_sum
cases.query: SELECT k,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(v) AS s FROM a GROUP BY k

cases.name: group_only
cases.query: SELECT k,label FROM a GROUP BY k,label

cases.name: group_ordinals
cases.query: SELECT k,label,COUNT(*) AS n FROM a GROUP BY 1,2

cases.name: aggregate_expression
cases.query: SELECT k,COALESCE(SUM(v),0)+COUNT(*) AS earnings FROM a GROUP BY k

cases.name: having
cases.query: SELECT k,SUM(v) AS s FROM a GROUP BY k HAVING COUNT(*)>1 AND SUM(v)>0

cases.name: having_alias
cases.query: SELECT k,SUM(v) AS earnings FROM a GROUP BY k HAVING earnings>0
cases.pg_query: SELECT k,SUM(v) AS earnings FROM a GROUP BY k HAVING SUM(v)>0

cases.name: empty_having
cases.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(v) AS s FROM a HAVING COUNT(*)=0

cases.name: aggregate_filter
cases.query: SELECT k,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE v>0) AS n,SUM(v) FILTER(WHERE v>0) AS s,AVG(v) FILTER(WHERE v<0) AS mean FROM a GROUP BY k

cases.name: distinct_aggs
cases.query: SELECT k,COUNT(DISTINCT v) AS n,SUM(DISTINCT v) AS s,AVG(DISTINCT v) AS mean,MIN(v) AS lo,MAX(v) AS hi FROM a GROUP BY k

cases.name: case_cast
cases.query: SELECT id,CASE WHEN v>0 THEN CAST(v AS TEXT) WHEN v IS NULL THEN label ELSE upper(label) END AS status FROM a

cases.name: like
cases.query: SELECT id,replace(label,'a','A') AS label FROM a WHERE label LIKE 'a%'
cases.pg_query: SELECT id,replace(label,'a','A') AS label FROM a WHERE label ILIKE 'a%'

cases.name: cte_columns
cases.query: WITH x(farm,region,crates) AS(SELECT id,k,v FROM a), y(region,price) AS(SELECT k,w FROM b) SELECT farm,x.region,crates,price FROM x JOIN y ON x.region=y.region

cases.name: cte_shared
cases.query: WITH x AS(SELECT id,k,v FROM a WHERE v>0) SELECT x.id AS x,y.id AS y FROM x JOIN x y ON x.k=y.k

cases.name: distinct_topk
cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT k FROM a ORDER BY k NULLS LAST LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

cases.name: group_topk
cases.query: SELECT k,SUM(v) AS total FROM a GROUP BY k HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY total DESC,k NULLS LAST LIMIT 2
cases.pg_query: SELECT k,SUM(v) AS total FROM a GROUP BY k HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST,k NULLS LAST LIMIT 2

cases.name: aggregate_limit_zero
cases.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM a LIMIT 0

cases.name: hidden_order
cases.query: SELECT id FROM a ORDER BY v DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

cases.name: ordinal_order
cases.query: SELECT id,v FROM a ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST,1 LIMIT 2

cases.name: compound_topk
cases.query: SELECT k FROM a UNION SELECT k FROM b ORDER BY k NULLS LAST LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

cases.name: bag_topk
cases.query: SELECT v FROM a UNION ALL SELECT w FROM b ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2

cases.name: window_multi
cases.query: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v,id) AS rn,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v) AS r,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v) AS dr FROM a
cases.pg_query: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST,id) AS rn,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST) AS r,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST) AS dr FROM a

cases.name: window_frame
cases.query: SELECT id,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving,LAG(v,1,-9) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS previous,LEAD(v) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS next FROM a
cases.pg_query: SELECT id,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving,LAG(v,1,-9) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS previous,LEAD(v) OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id) AS next FROM a

cases.name: window_named
cases.query: SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(v) OVER w AS first,LAST_VALUE(v) OVER w AS last FROM a WINDOW w AS(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
cases.pg_query: SELECT id,FIRST_VALUE(v) OVER w AS first,LAST_VALUE(v) OVER w AS last FROM a WINDOW w AS(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)

cases.name: window_topk
cases.query: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v,id) AS rn FROM a ORDER BY rn,id LIMIT 3
cases.pg_query: SELECT id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY k ORDER BY v NULLS FIRST,id) AS rn FROM a ORDER BY rn,id LIMIT 3

cases.name: group_window
cases.query: SELECT k,total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY total DESC,k) AS rn FROM (SELECT k,SUM(v) AS total FROM a GROUP BY k) ORDER BY rn LIMIT 2
cases.pg_query: SELECT k,total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST,k NULLS FIRST) AS rn FROM (SELECT k,SUM(v) AS total FROM a GROUP BY k) ORDER BY rn LIMIT 2

cases.name: outer_aggregate
cases.query: SELECT a.k,COUNT(b.bid) AS n,SUM(b.w) AS s FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.k=b.k GROUP BY a.k

cases.name: nested_distinct
cases.query: SELECT k,COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k,v FROM a) GROUP BY k
